notes: Controller vibration. The original rumbles a pad only when the robot it pilots takes damage (0x07675e): that frame's damage is clamped to [floor, ceiling]; below short_below every step lasts short_scale as long; each motor's speed is scaled by the damage over full. The steps are the pattern at 0x232678, three {frames, heavy motor, light motor} ending at frames -1; speeds are XInput's 0-65535 (low is XInputSetState's left, low-frequency motor, high its right). frames are the original's 60 Hz frames (frame_rate).

The vibration option (OPTION > VIBRATION, saved with the settings) silences the motors; the original keeps running the pattern on a silent pad (bit 30 of 0x9cc passed to 0x0decb0). Pausing and leaving the battle stop the pad at once (0x0debc0).
